pairs.subject: background-jobs
pairs.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/NoReport.tsx:68 reconcile.run is a job of up to ten minutes (NoReport.tsx:52-53). While it runs, the page shows only a disabled 'Reconciling…' button and a start time, with no cancel control and no job id, so the cancellation and identity clauses of the job contract are not realized. The re-attach clause is realized: the run survives remounts.

techniques.evidence: apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/NoReport.tsx:68 A job of up to 10 minutes has no cancel request and no cancelling/cancelled states. The in-flight run is found by method kind (line 23, run.running[0]), not by a job id. The positives: progress is honestly indeterminate with a start time (line 74), and the run outlives the tab that started it (inflight.test.tsx).
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/hooks.ts:19 Reads go through the shared useRpc hook. The context runs no polling loop whose cadence it could adapt.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/CountUp.tsx:34 The only repeating callback here is a one-shot count-up animation, and its effect cleanup reaps it. It is not a recurring background loop.
apps/console/src/pages/reconcile/Layer1.tsx:48 The page only reads data. It keeps the last good reply on screen and labels it, but it owns no loop whose first tick could gate readiness.
